title: One page of the Health and Disability Commissioner's decisions listing, by year (www.hdc.org.nz/decisions/search-decisions/?filter-year=Y&page=N, HTML)

landmarks:
holding up to twelve tiles, each an

and a

date ("12 Oct 2026", "25 Sept 2017")
Page N of M (absent when the year fits on one page)
a filter form with selects filter-group-providers, filter-occupations, filter-rights, filter-year

signals_note: GET through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page with no listing pods is not this shape (a block page, an error page). The page asked for must be the page stated.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026: 168 pages unfiltered (1998 to 2026, 2,010 tiles: 167 × 12 + 6); 2017 is 5 pages, 49 tiles. Newest first. The tile's heading describes the consumer's care and is never kept; the fingerprint is the date and a hash of the heading. The year filter is the address's year folder, which can differ from the page's own date (a 2023 folder page dated 22 February 2024).
applies_to: the Commissioner's decisions listing, 2017 on, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; a page not of this shape stops the pass (set aside).
One listed item per tile: slug, address, date, fingerprint.
gates: Each year's finished pass walked the pages its first page stated; every page before the last carried twelve tiles (check.py).
on_fail: set the page aside; the run stops; the pass resumes from it next run

title: One decision of the Health and Disability Commissioner (www.hdc.org.nz/decisions/search-decisions/<year>/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks: DD Mon YYYY in the page header
a hidden list of Group providers :, Occupations :, Rights : each with values
<div class="t-link-parent c-rte__body-text"> holding the whole decision
from 2026 a hidden CAS-… id; before, the address is the file number (15hdc01415, 16hdc01786-18hdc01259)

signals_note: GET the tile's address through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash. A page with no dated header or no body block is not this shape. The linked PDF is the same decision and is not fetched.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026 on twelve pages, 2017 to 2026. Two drafting forms on one template. To 2025: an italic notice 'Names have been removed (except …) to protect privacy', then a parties block of h2 headings (one party per line break: 'Waikato District Health Board', 'Registrar, Dr D'), then 'Opinion: <party> — <finding>' headings. From 2026: no parties block; the provider is defined in the first paragraph ('Ultimate Care Oakland (UCO; trading as …)'), findings are headed 'Decision: UCO – breach', and an advice appendix carries 'PROVIDER : <name>' and 'FILE NUMBER : C22HDC00991'. A provider the Commissioner does not name is described by its kind ('the DHB', 'Pharmacy', 'Disability service'). Consumers, family and anonymised practitioners are a title and a letter, assigned in order. Naming follows the Commissioner's Policy for Naming Providers (June 2023): individuals only on its grounds (wilful disregard, public safety, non-compliance, frequent breaches, other).
applies_to: the Commissioner's decision pages, 2017 on, from 21 October 2026
process: Recognise the page; set it aside whole if it is not the shape.

One decision row keyed by the address's slug: file number (from the slug, else the number the page states most), date, provider kinds, occupations and rights as tagged, rights stated as breached (not negated, not a question), findings per party heading, recommendation headings and addressees, named individuals as roles with the naming policy's ground.

One provider row per organisation the page names: the notice's exceptions, the parties block, a finding heading or addressee resolved through the page's definition, an advice header's PROVIDER line; a name of provider-kind words only is the Commissioner's anonymisation and not a row.
Never kept: the heading, any paragraph, a letter label, a practitioner's name, staff and advisers. Every kept text passes the consumer-detail guard.
gates: Every listed page is a row, a catch-log line or 'not captured' (check.py).
No view carries a heading, an address, a value describing a consumer, or a person-shaped provider (check.py).

title: One case study of the Health and Disability Commissioner (www.hdc.org.nz/decisions/case-studies-nga-matai-take/<slug>/, HTML)

landmarks: no hidden category list, no parties block, no notice

signals_note: GET the tile's address through the fetch gate, 5 s apart; landed verbatim by hash.
notes: Seen 21 October 2026 on two pages: a summary of a decision or of a complaint resolved without one; it may state a file number (22HDC00499) and names Health NZ by definition ('Health New Zealand|Te Whatu Ora (Health NZ)').
applies_to: the case study pages, from 21 October 2026
process: One row, kind 'case study', keyed by its slug's hash: the date, a file number where stated, rights stated as breached.
A provider row only where the page names no provider any other way and a breach statement names a defined organisation.
gates: No case study shows its own address on a view (check.py).
